context.problem_statement: You are tasked with performing a Market Basket Analysis on an eCommerce dataset to identify strong association rules among purchased items. The dataset contains transaction records with transformed column names. Use the Apriori or FP-Growth algorithm to find frequent itemsets with a minimum support threshold of 0.01. Then, generate association rules with a minimum confidence threshold of 0.5. Provide a summary of the top 5 rules based on lift, and compute the average lift across all generated rules.
context.expert_knowledge: In eCommerce, Market Basket Analysis is used to identify associations between purchased items. Apriori and FP-Growth algorithms are commonly applied to discover frequent itemsets and generate association rules. Association rules help in understanding customer purchasing behavior and can be used for recommendations.
